title: Outlook Shared Mailbox Guide
problem: Employee cannot access or use a shared mailbox in Microsoft Outlook.
prerequisites: The Server Team has granted access to the shared mailbox.
The employee is connected to the corporate network or VPN.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Restart Outlook
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Close Microsoft Outlook completely and reopen it. Shared mailboxes are usually added automatically after permissions are granted.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Restart Outlook

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Mailbox Appears
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Check the Folder Pane to see whether the shared mailbox appears automatically.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Folder Pane

troubleshooting_steps.title: Manually Add Shared Mailbox
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Go to File → Account Settings → Change → More Settings → Advanced → Add, then enter the shared mailbox email address.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Add Shared Mailbox

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Sending Permissions
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Create a new email and verify that the shared mailbox is available in the From field.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: From Address

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Shared Calendar
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Open Calendar view and verify that the shared calendar appears.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Shared Calendar

verification: Emails can be sent from the shared mailbox.

common_errors.resolution: Restart Outlook and wait a few minutes after mailbox permissions are assigned.
Contact the Server Team to verify mailbox permissions.
Verify Send As or Send on Behalf permissions.

escalation.condition: Escalate if the mailbox still does not appear after manual configuration or permissions are incorrect.

faq.question: Can I log into Windows using a shared mailbox?
faq.answer: No. Shared mailboxes are only used within Outlook.

faq.question: Why can't I see the shared mailbox?
faq.answer: The Server Team may still be assigning permissions. Restart Outlook and try again.

faq.question: Can multiple users access the mailbox?
faq.answer: Yes. Shared mailboxes are designed for team collaboration.
